result.question: Who should I start Trey Mcbride or Bowers for week 7
result.answer: Start Brock Bowers over Trey McBride. Bowers = Brock Bowers, LV TE. Brock Bowers holds the head-to-head production edge: he averages 20.6 PPR points per game this season to McBride's 17.2, and over weeks 4-6 Bowers averaged 18.2 PPR points per game versus McBride's 14.7. While McBride enjoys a better defensive matchup in week 7 (DEN allows 13.2 PPR to TEs, rank 15, versus LA's 8.3 PPR allowed, rank 31), Bowers's consistent production advantage across all periods, combined with his 33.9% air yards share and 10.8 targets per game, makes him the stronger start.

evidence.sql: SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND LOWER(full_name) IN ('trey mcbride', 'who should', 'should i', 'i start', 'start trey', 'mcbride or', 'or bowers', 'bowers for', 'for week', 'who should i', 'should i start', 'i start trey', 'start trey mcbride', 'trey mcbride or', 'mcbride or bowers', 'or bowers for', 'bowers for week') GROUP BY gsis_id) latest ON r.gsis_id = latest.gsis_id AND r.week = latest.week WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Brock Bowers: LV, TE, 82.2 PPR points this season.

evidence.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') AND (LOWER(full_name) LIKE '% bowers' OR LOWER(full_name) LIKE '% bowers %') GROUP BY gsis_id), pts AS (SELECT player_id, ROUND(SUM(fantasy_points_ppr), 1) AS season_points FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats WHERE season = 2026 GROUP BY player_id) SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week, p.season_points AS season_ppr_points FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN latest l ON r.gsis_id = l.gsis_id AND r.week = l.week LEFT JOIN pts p ON p.player_id = r.gsis_id WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Bowers averaged 27.6 PPR points per game in weeks 1-3 compared to McBride's 19.7, and his target share dropped from 43.3% to 24.6% while McBride's remained more stable at 31.9% to 27.5%.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, 3 AS split_week, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_games, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_games, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS early_ppr_per_game, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS late_ppr_per_game, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS early_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS late_target_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Brock Bowers faces the LA defense which allows 8.3 PPR points per game to TEs (rank 31), while Trey McBride faces the DEN defense which allows 13.2 PPR points per game to TEs (rank 15).
